name: time
desc: Pixel-clock state. Formats time_str and display_hour from the shared minute tick (no timer of its own), dirties the time layer solely on change. Owns the 24-hour setting: persisted Clay toggle, phone-synced.

clay.label: 24-Hour Time
clay.description: Turn off to use the 12-hour time format.

cost.wakeups: none beyond the shared minute tick (no separate subscription)
cost.redraws: time layer, only when the formatted time changes
cost.persist: 24h flag, written solely when the setting changes
cost.notes: Styles (pixel font, scale, color, box, conditional overrides) stay in the design's pixeltext layer; the widget only feeds state.
